phases.name: Foundation
phases.what: Learn the 7 moves with clean form and build the step habit. 2 rounds in week 1, then 3.

phases.name: Build
phases.what: Longer holds and more reps. First retest on day 15: your waist should be moving.

phases.name: Carve
phases.what: The harder versions: the full hollow, straight-leg raises and a water jug on the crunch.

phases.name: Reveal
phases.what: 4 rounds of abs and 10,000 steps. Final test on day 60.

moves.name: Front plank
how: Forearms on the floor, elbows right under your shoulders.
Step your feet back. Your body is one straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach, as if someone is about to poke it.
Breathe normally. Stop when your hips sag or lift.
moves.works: The whole front: the six-pack (rectus abdominis) and the deep muscle under it.
moves.avoid: Hips sagging toward the floor, or hips up in the air. Holding your breath.
moves.easy: Knees on the floor, or hands on a chair.
moves.hard: Shoulder taps: lift one hand at a time without letting your hips rock.
moves.safe: If your lower back aches, drop to your knees or shorten the hold.

moves.name: Reverse crunch
how: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, knees bent at 90° above your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor and bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly, for 2 to 3 seconds, until your hips touch down.
No swinging. If your legs fly, your abs aren't doing the work.
moves.works: The lower part of the six-pack, which curls your pelvis up.
moves.avoid: Swinging your legs for momentum. Pushing hard with your hands.
moves.easy: A smaller range: just lift your hips a little.
moves.hard: Slower: 4 seconds down. Or straighten your legs a little.

moves.name: Flat-back bug
how: Lie on your back, arms up to the ceiling, knees bent at 90° over your hips.
Press your lower back flat into the floor, and keep it there the whole time.
Slowly reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, just above the floor.
Come back to the middle and switch sides. That's 1 rep per side.
moves.works: The deep brace that keeps your stomach flat, plus the six-pack holding still.
moves.avoid: Your lower back lifting off the floor. Rushing.
moves.easy: Move only the leg; keep both arms up.
moves.hard: Slower, with a 2-second pause at full reach.

moves.name: Side plank
how: Lie on your side, forearm on the floor, elbow right under your shoulder.
Stack your feet, or put the top foot just in front.
Lift your hips until your body is one straight line from head to feet.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides. Both sides get the same time.
moves.works: The obliques at your sides: the lines that frame a six-pack.
moves.avoid: Hips sagging. Your shoulder shrugging up to your ear.
moves.hard: Lift the top leg, or reach the top arm to the ceiling.

moves.name: Squeeze crunch
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. From CARVE on, hug a water jug to your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor: ribs toward hips.
At the top, squeeze your abs hard for 2 seconds.
Lower slowly. Never pull on your neck.
moves.works: The six-pack itself. This is the move that grows the blocks, so it gets load later.
moves.avoid: Yanking your head with your hands. Bouncing up and down fast.
moves.easy: Arms reaching forward to your knees.
moves.hard: A heavier jug, or a backpack with books.

moves.name: Hollow hold
how: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor. Arms reach forward, or past your head.
Your body makes a shallow banana shape. Your lower back stays down.
Hold and breathe. When your back lifts, bend your knees or stop.
moves.works: The whole front of your core at once: the shape gymnasts train.
moves.avoid: Your lower back arching off the floor. Holding your breath.
moves.easy: The tuck: knees bent in, arms forward (FOUNDATION).
moves.hard: Legs lower and arms overhead (CARVE and REVEAL).

moves.name: Lying leg raise
how: Lie on your back, hands flat by your hips, lower back pressed down.
Keep your legs together and lift them to about 45°. In FOUNDATION, bend your knees.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
If your lower back lifts, stop higher or bend your knees.
moves.works: The lower six-pack and the hip flexors.
moves.avoid: Arching your lower back. Dropping your legs fast.
moves.hard: Got a pull-up bar? Hanging knee raises, 8 to 12, in CARVE and REVEAL.
moves.safe: Sensitive lower back? Keep your knees bent, or swap this move for reverse crunches.

approach.v: No calorie counting and no banned foods. Your hand is your measuring cup.

v.examples: meat, fish, eggs, tofu, Greek yoghurt
any kind, the more the better

smaller_people.v: If you're smaller, use 1 palm of protein per meal instead of 2, and use the same weekly check.

protein_target.v: About 1.6 g per kg of body weight a day (0.7 g per lb).

rate_of_loss.v: About 0.5 to 1% of your body weight a week.

drink.v: Drink water, not calories. Soda, juice and sweet coffees add up fast.

eating_pace.v: Eat slowly and stop at 80% full.

treats.v: Plan your treats. One you really want beats five you didn't.

v: To cut out whole food groups

weekly_check.v: Waist down, or weight average down? Change nothing. Nothing moved for 2 weeks in a row? Take away one cupped hand of carbs or one thumb of fat a day, and keep everything else the same. Feeling weak, dizzy or hungry all the time? Add one back.

v: Protein first: a protein-heavy snack before you go, start your plate with the meat or fish.
One plate, sitting down: fill one plate, sit, eat slowly.
Pick your favourites: have the dessert you actually love.
One drink, one water: a glass of water between alcoholic drinks.
Walk after the big meal: 10 to 20 minutes.
No "start on Monday": the next meal is a normal meal, the next day a normal plan day.

calories_or_macro_numbers_beyond_hand_ru.why: The programme says no calorie counting; no calorie or gram targets are published except protein 1.6 g/kg.

food_lists_or_recipes.why: PDF pages beyond the 10 previews are not public.

day_60.v: Final test day: no workout; steps 10,000.

conditions.v: Do it on day 1 before your first session. Same time of day and before you eat, so the numbers mean something.

measure_waist.v: Wrap the tape around your waist at belly-button height. Breathe out normally, don't suck in, and write down the number. Same spot every time.

max_plank.v: Hold a front plank as long as you can with good form. Stop the clock when your hips sag or lift.

string_test.v: Cut a piece of string as long as you are tall and fold it in half. If it fits around your waist, your waist is under half your height.

photo.v: Front and side, same spot, same light, same time of day, relaxed. Keep them on your phone.

weight_optional.v: Weigh yourself every morning for a week and use the average.

waist_to_height_target.v: Keep your waist under half your height.

v.Reveal: 4 on ab days (full-body days stay at 3 in the page data)

round_structure.v: Do the 3 moves back to back, rest 45 seconds, repeat.

effort.v: Finish each set with 1 or 2 good reps left. Shaky is fine. Sloppy is not.

dose_progression.v: The moves stay the same and the doses grow each phase (see exercises.json dose_by_phase).

squeeze_crunch_load.v: Water jug from Carve; heavier jug or backpack with books is the harder version.

leg_raise_progression.v: Knees bent (Foundation) -> straight legs from Carve; hanging knee raises 8-12 optional with a pull-up bar in Carve and Reveal.

weekly_adjustment.v: Nothing moved for 2 weeks in a row? Take away one cupped hand of carbs or one thumb of fat a day, and keep everything else the same. Feeling weak, dizzy or hungry all the time? Add one back.

load_progression_numbers.why: No publicly exposed rule gives weights/jug size; only 'jug' and 'bag' qualifiers.

count_from_start.v: Days count from your start, not from the calendar. Missed days push the plan back; they don't break it (page 20).

start_any_day.v: Day 1 is whatever day you start. The plan works any time of year.

party_rule.v: The next meal is a normal meal, and the next day is a normal plan day. One big meal changes almost nothing. A lost week does.

missed_day_plan_detail.why: Page 20 ('Missed days') is referenced by page 19 but is not a public preview page. How many days to repeat or skip is not published.

three_mistakes_and_questions.why: PDF pages with '3 mistakes' and 'questions' are not public.
